acceptance.given: A Matrix aggregate evaluation has the required six distinct Matrix Case inputs and both-subject execution records, with one required Case/subject execution deliberately absent.

oracle.expected: The aggregate reports failure because required execution coverage is incomplete.
forbidden: The aggregate reports success with a missing required execution.
The missing Matrix Case execution is ignored.
oracle.observable: The aggregate verdict and coverage diagnostic identify the missing required Matrix Case input or subject execution.

acceptance.then: Aggregate success remains unavailable until every required Matrix Case input and both-subject execution is present.
acceptance.when: The Matrix aggregate assesses required execution coverage.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S32 aggregate test with a required Case/subject execution omitted from the matrix fixture.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make Matrix aggregate evaluation reject incomplete required Matrix Case input or subject-execution coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-schema change; removing the aggregate coverage gate restores prior toolchain behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix aggregate evaluation with incomplete required coverage transitions to a failed aggregate result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A Matrix aggregate passes only when all required Matrix Case inputs and both-subject executions are present; an omitted required execution yields failed.

acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer has a recorded Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline before its real-call-surface enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable sequence.

oracle.expected: After the full sequence, the Consumer observes its Prior Route identity and its verdict and diagnostic baseline.
forbidden: Prior Route identity is not restored.
The verdict baseline is not restored.
The diagnostic baseline is not restored.
oracle.observable: The route-sequence result for the applicable Consumer records identity equal to the Prior Route identity and verdict and diagnostics equal to their recorded baseline.

acceptance.then: The applicable Consumer returns to the recorded Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline.
acceptance.when: The Consumer executes enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable through its real call surface.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 real-call-surface route-sequence test with a restored identity, verdict, or diagnostic differing from the recorded prior baseline.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute each applicable Consumer's enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable sequence through real call surfaces and restore its Prior Route identity plus verdict/diagnostic baseline.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-schema change; behavioral rollback returns the Consumer route to its recorded prior identity and baseline.

slice_hint.state_transition: An applicable Consumer transitions from recorded prior baseline through enable, disable, and rollback, then re-enable, back to its recorded prior identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: After the complete real-call-surface sequence, the Consumer's Route identity, verdict, and diagnostics exactly equal its recorded prior baseline.

acceptance.given: A toolchain aggregate execution is configured with a finite output limit and produces output while it runs.

oracle.expected: The aggregate output remains at or below its configured finite limit and reaches a deterministic terminal state; output-budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.
forbidden: An aggregate produces output without a bound.
oracle.observable: The aggregate execution result exposes its configured finite output limit, emitted output amount, and deterministic unsuccessful terminal result when the output budget is exhausted.

acceptance.then: The aggregate remains bounded by its finite output limit, and exhaustion produces an unsuccessful deterministic terminal result.
acceptance.when: The aggregate executes and produces output.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S11 aggregate-budget test with unbounded output configuration or output exceeding the configured finite limit.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce a finite output bound for toolchain aggregate execution and emit a deterministic unsuccessful terminal result on output-budget exhaustion.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-schema change; reverting removes the aggregate output-bound enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: An aggregate execution producing output remains within its configured finite limit or transitions deterministically to unsuccessful on budget exhaustion.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every aggregate execution has a finite output limit, never exceeds it, and reports output-budget exhaustion as unsuccessful.

acceptance.given: The Consumer Manifest contains one or more non-empty entries, each with a recorded Prior Behavior Baseline before rollback.

oracle.expected: After rollback, every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry observes its Prior Behavior Baseline.
forbidden: A non-empty Consumer Manifest entry does not observe the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.
oracle.observable: The rollback result enumerates every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry and shows baseline observation for all entries, with no omitted or divergent entry.

acceptance.then: One hundred percent of non-empty Consumer Manifest entries observe their Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.
acceptance.when: Rollback completes for the non-empty Consumer Manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 rollback test with one non-empty Consumer Manifest entry missing or divergent from its recorded Prior Behavior Baseline.

slice_hint.behavior_change: After rollback, evaluate every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry through the real replay route and require each to observe its own Prior Behavior Baseline.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-schema change; rollback restores each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry's recorded Prior Behavior Baseline.

slice_hint.state_transition: Each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry transitions through rollback to observation of its recorded Prior Behavior Baseline.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Rollback succeeds only if every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry observes its recorded Prior Behavior Baseline; any missing or divergent entry fails.
